sv.title: C-toppen tar strid mot partiledningen
sv.summary: C-toppen Abir Al-Sahlani tar strid mot partiledningen. ”Man kan kompromissa om sakpolitik, men inte om sina grundläggande värderingar” skriver hon i Dagens Nyheter.

en.title: C-top challenges party leadership
en.summary: C-top Abir Al-Sahlani challenges the party leadership. "One can compromise on policy, but not on one's basic values," she writes in Dagens Nyheter.
